Strawberry Margarita
By: Anita Mokashi
Published: Monday, August 6, 2012 - 11:37pm

Ingredients




8 to 10 hulled fresh strawberries or 4 ounces frozen sliced strawberries
4 ounces tequila
1 1/2 ounces Triple Sec
4 fluid ounces frozen lemonade concentrate
Lots of ice (about 1 to 2 cups ice cubes)
Coarse salt or sugar, for rimming the glass
Whole fresh strawberries, garnish
Lime slices garnish

Preparation

1 In a blender, combine strawberries, tequila, lemonade, Tripe Sec, and ice; blend until smooth. 2 Pour into stemmed Margarita Glasses rimmed with either coarse salt, or coarse sugar. 3 To create a salt or sugar-rimmed glass, take a lime wedge and rub the drinking surface of the glass so it is barely moist. Dip the edge of the glass into coarse salt or sugar.Garnish with a whole strawberry 4 Makes 2 to 3 serving.
